name: 🎙️ AI Travel Guide Voice Bot
description: A sophisticated real-time AI travel guide powered by AssemblyAI, OpenAI, and ElevenLabs. This intelligent voice bot provides personalized travel recommendations and answers questions with natural-sounding AI voice.

name: 🧠 DeepSeek Thinking UI
description: A professional ChatGPT-like interface with visible reasoning powered by DeepSeek-R1. Experience AI thinking process in real-time with an intuitive user interface.

name: ⚡ LLM Quantization Zoo
description: A collection of hands-on notebooks demonstrating various model quantization techniques, including GPTQ, GGUF, ExLlamaV2, and 8-bit quantization for efficient model deployment.

name: 📚 LLM Finetuning Cookbook
description: A hands-on, code-first cookbook for fine-tuning Large Language Models (LLMs) across various techniques and tasks. No frills, just practical code and real-world applications.

name: 🎯 Ensemble Learning Tutorial
description: A comprehensive machine learning project demonstrating ensemble learning techniques including bagging, boosting, and stacking methods with Jupyter notebooks and Docker support.

name: 👁️ Attention Captioning Tutorial
description: PyTorch implementation of image captioning with and without attention mechanisms using Flickr8K dataset. Learn the fundamentals of computer vision and natural language processing.

name: 🔧 Deep Learning Optimization Tutorial
description: Interactive deep learning optimization tutorial with Jupyter notebooks. Master neural network tuning, hyperparameter optimization, and model performance techniques through practical exercises.

name: 📈 Trading Floor Agent
description: Production-ready autonomous trading floor with 4 AI agents making trades, powered by 6 MCP servers and 44 tools. Features real-time dashboard, portfolio analytics, and Docker support.

name: 🤖 Agent Creator
description: AI agent that creates other AI agents using AutoGen. Features dynamic agent generation, gRPC runtime, Streamlit UI, and Docker support for scalable agent communication.

name: 🦸 Sidekick Agent
description: LangGraph-powered personal AI co-worker that works in your browser. Can browse the web, run Python code, search Wikipedia, manage files, and more - your own version of OpenAI's Operator Agent.

name: 👷 Engineering Team Agent
description: 4-agent CrewAI system that designs, builds, tests, and creates UI for software modules. Takes high-level requirements and produces complete, tested solutions with Docker support.

name: 📊 Stock Picker Agent
description: AI-powered investment research and stock selection agent built with CrewAI. Uses specialized agents to find trending companies, conduct financial research, and select investment opportunities.

name: 🔍 Deep Research
description: Multi-agent research system that conducts comprehensive research on any topic. Orchestrates specialized agents to plan searches, gather information, synthesize reports, and send results via email.

name: 📧 SDR Agent
description: AI-powered Sales Development Representative that crafts and sends professional cold emails. Uses OpenAI to generate personalized emails and supports bulk sending via SendGrid or SMTP.

name: 👤 Career Digital Twin
description: AI agent that represents you to potential employers. Uses your resume, LinkedIn profile, and personal summary to answer questions about your career, skills, and experience.
